summary: Icon-only button for toolbar and utility actions; the default slot takes the icon and the label attribute names it.

usage.text: Unlike violet-button it forwards no aria-expanded, aria-pressed, aria-haspopup or aria-controls. For a toggle or popup trigger use violet-button with its ariaLabel property.
Not form-associated: type="submit" or "reset" does not submit or reset an enclosing form. Call form.requestSubmit() from a click listener.
Slot one violet-icon, svg or img; it is sized to fill the button's icon area. The default appearance is secondary.

a11y.text: Set the label attribute: it is the inner button's only accessible name and also its hover tooltip. Mark the slotted violet-icon decorative.
